title: Travel, Never & Everyday Recommendations
subtitle: Use Present Perfect with never, describe places, and make practical recommendations.

units.title: Never, Places & Recommendations
units.tagline: Connect life experiences, travel reading and useful everyday questions.
notes: Use Present Perfect with never for an experience that has not happened: I have never visited a castle.
Never is already negative. Do not add don't or haven't: I have never travelled by underground is correct.
Ask about frequency with How often ...? and answer with always, usually, sometimes or never.
Use recommend + verb-ing for advice: I recommend reading while you wait.

vocabulary.meaning: a city railway system below the streets; also called the metro
vocabulary.example: We took the underground to the museum.

vocabulary.meaning: a place where trains or buses arrive and leave
vocabulary.example: The station is near the old market.

vocabulary.meaning: to say that something is a good idea
vocabulary.example: I recommend trying the local soup.

vocabulary.meaning: a large, strong building from the past
vocabulary.example: The castle stands above the town.

vocabulary.meaning: a large area full of trees
vocabulary.example: They walked through the forest with a guide.

vocabulary.meaning: the line between two countries or areas
vocabulary.example: The village is close to the border.

grammar.title: Present Perfect with never
grammar.rule: have/has + never + past participle kullanılır. Hayatta hiç yaşanmamış bir deneyimi anlatır; belirli bir zaman söylemeyiz.
examples: I have never seen a bear in the wild.
Lena has never travelled by underground.
Have you ever visited a castle? — No, I have never visited one.

grammar.title: Frequency and recommendations
grammar.rule: How often ile alışkanlık ve sıklık sorulur. Tavsiye verirken recommend + -ing kullan: I recommend taking the train.
examples: How often do you take the underground?
I usually take it at weekends.
What do you recommend doing while waiting for a train?

units.remember: have/has + never + üçüncü hâl: have never seen, has never gone, have never been.
units.watchOut: 'I haven't never been' çift olumsuzdur. 'I have never been' kullan.

practice.hint: After have, use the past participle.

practice.prompt: Choose the accurate sentence about a bear.
options: She has never saw a bear.
She has never seen a bear.
She never has see a bear.

practice.prompt: How often do you take the underground?
options: I usually take it on Fridays.
I recommend reading while you wait.
I recommend to read while you wait.
I recommend read while you wait.

practice.prompt: A place where trains arrive and leave is a ___.
Which word means 'to say something is a good idea'?

reading.title: Beyond the Forest
reading.text: Nora has never believed stories about vampires, but she loves visiting old places. Last month, she travelled to a town beyond a large forest. The town had a stone castle, narrow streets and a small railway station. A guide explained that the region has many wild animals, so visitors should stay on the paths. Nora took photographs of the castle and then waited for her train in a café near the station. She recommends reading about a place before visiting it, because history can make a journey more interesting.

questions.prompt: When did Nora travel to the town?
Why should visitors stay on the paths?
options: There are wild animals in the region.
Reading about a place before visiting

listening.title: Waiting for the Train
listening.script: Ece: We have twenty minutes before the train arrives. What do you recommend doing? Omar: I recommend getting a drink and looking at the map. Have you ever been to this part of the city? Ece: No, I have never been here. I usually take the underground, so this station is new for me. Omar: Then let's find the museum on the map. It is close to the river.

questions.prompt: How long do Ece and Omar have before the train arrives?

options: Getting a drink and looking at the map

questions.prompt: What place is close to the river?

speaking.title: Practical Travel Talk
speaking.prompt: Ask a partner two Have you ever ...? questions about places or transport. Then ask one How often ...? question and give one recommendation for a station or a journey.

writing.title: A Place to Recommend
writing.prompt: Write 7–9 sentences about an interesting place. Include one sentence with have never, one How often question with an answer, and one recommendation using recommend + -ing.

finalQuiz.prompt: They have never ___ the underground at night.
